facts.text: Under the First State Promise, Delaware freshmen with family income under $35,000 receive aid covering tuition, fees, standard housing, and food expenses.

sources.title: In-State Freshmen | University of Delaware
sources.quote: Students with a family income of less than $35,000 receive a financial package that allows them to attend UD at little or no up-front cost. The package covers tuition, fees, standard housing and food expenses.
